name: veritastrader
description: VeritasTrader — plataforma de trading multiproduto em SIMULAÇÃO

scripts.build: npm run build -w @veritas/shared && npm run build -w @veritas/db && npm run build -w @veritas/api && npm run build -w @veritas/worker && npm run build -w @veritas/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,worker,web -c orange,magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @veritas/api" "npm run dev -w @veritas/worker" "npm run dev -w @veritas/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @veritas/shared && npm run typecheck -w @veritas/api && npm run typecheck -w @veritas/worker && npm run typecheck -w @veritas/web
